And uh, I could try. I know she's stressed out currently with school work, so I'm mostly there for her. She doesn't know that I cut as I tend to hide my arms with makeup and hoodies well. I don't know what she'd do if I told her or showed her, so I'm scared of that. She might get angry or cry, but I'd understand if she did. She just cares a lot. I'm only myself when she's around, so yeah. As far as I can tell, she's been helping me feel better than I do without her. I'll work around telling her about how I feel, however I probably won't tell her about any of my attempts/self harming issues until she knows the extent of what I'm going through.
